title: US equity and options markets closed — Christmas Day observed (Friday 2027-12-24; December 2027 carries NO early close at all, and 2027-12-31 stays a full session)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell by cell by this session, which is the CANONICAL file written by the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 initial research after reading both sibling proposals for this id. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Christmas Day row parses as ['Friday, December 25****', 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)', 'Monday, December 25'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, so 2027 is a FULL closure on Friday December 24. THE FOOTNOTES SETTLE THE REST OF THE 2027 YEAR-END WEEK AND ARE THE REASON THIS ENTRY MATTERS MORE THAN A HOLIDAY ROW: footnote **** names exactly ONE December early close across all three years — 'Thursday, December 24, 2026' — so December 2027 has no 1:00 p.m. ET session anywhere in it, and footnote * reads verbatim 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed', which keeps Friday 2027-12-31 a full equity session. INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED FROM A SECOND PRIMARY the same session: the OCC's own expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2027-12-24 {"holiday":{"description":"Exchange/OCC holiday","hatched":true}} and marks no other late-December 2027 date that way, while marking 2027-12-31 a 'Quarterly Expiration date'. REPRODUCED A THIRD TIME FROM SESSION RECORDS RATHER THAN CALENDARS, ON TWO INDEPENDENT SERIES: Christmas Day 2027 is a Saturday, and across the five prior Saturday-Christmas years since 1990 — 1993, 1999, 2004, 2010, 2021 — December 24 is absent and December 23, 27 and 31 are all present, 5 of 5 on BOTH CBOE's VIX_History.csv (9,267 sessions, 1990-01-02 to 2026-09-07) and FRED's NASDAQCOM (9,238 sessions, same window). The two series disagree on exactly ONE December date in 36 years — 1999-12-31, present in FRED and absent from the CBOE file — which is a CBOE series gap, not a closure, and is recorded here because the sibling proposal from fhfa-hpi-2027-12-28 counted Saturday-Christmas Decembers off the CBOE file alone. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents (labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts, and this lane's own no-self-confirm limit. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this id's own initial research (2026-09-08), which read both sibling proposals first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md — proposals/christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24.from-consumer-confidence-2027-12-22.json and .from-fhfa-hpi-2027-12-28.json — and then re-fetched every primary rather than inheriting either. Both proposals are correct that 2027-12-24 is a closure and that there is no Christmas Eve half session in 2027. TWO OF THEIR SECONDARY CLAIMS DO NOT SURVIVE MEASUREMENT AND ARE CORRECTED HERE. (1) 'The closure leaves 2027's year-end corridor short one session on each side' is WRONG: December 2027 carries 22 sessions, the MAXIMUM in the 1990-2025 record (range 19-22), because the Saturday-New-Year rule in NYSE footnote * keeps 12-31 open and offsets the 12-24 closure. A lane budgeting sessions for December 2027 should use 22, not a decremented 2024/2025 template. (2) 'Saturday-Christmas is a structurally distinct configuration' is NOT SUPPORTED: measured on the CBOE VIX file, the close-to-close change across the Christmas break is a function of GAP LENGTH and nothing else — 3 non-trading days gives mean +4.32% / median +4.01% / 16 of 20 positive, 1 non-trading day gives mean -0.11% / median +0.08% / 7 of 14 positive, and the five Saturday-Christmas years (+5.08%, n=5) are indistinguishable from the other fifteen 3-day-gap years (+4.07%, n=15). 2027 inherits the ordinary long-gap re-mark, not a Saturday-specific one. THE FINDING NEITHER PROPOSAL HAS, and the reason this row is worth carrying: SIFMA's own 2027 US Holiday Recommendations panel (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes, parsed out of the page's embedded payload because the 2027 tab is hidden) puts a 2:00 p.m. ET early US fixed-income close on BOTH Thursday 2027-12-23 and Friday 2027-12-31 — the second one attached to a 'New Year's Day 2027/2028' row that carries NO full-close date, exactly as NYSE footnote * predicts. Both of those days are FULL NYSE equity sessions, and 2027-12-31 is additionally an OCC quarterly expiration and the last session of the year. So the 2027 year-end corridor holds two dated cross-asset schedule asymmetries, proposed in the same PR as sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23 and sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-31. DO NOT file a companion christmas-eve-half-day-2027-12-24 — the absence of the half session IS the finding, and such a row would be a false calendar entry; contrast christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24, which is real because Christmas 2026 is a Friday. THE PROMOTION PATH IS NARROWER THAN THE SIBLING LEDGERS SAY: they each write that the taxonomy 'has no slot for an exchange's own holiday calendar', but market-events-data.ts DOES carry a confirmed `OCC:` prefix, scoped in its header to the 'options-expiration calendar (theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard)'. Whether that prefix covers the same calendar's HOLIDAY markers — which is what settles this event — is an unanswered scoping question, not an absent slot, and it is one taxonomy call away from promoting this and every sibling closure entry at once. This lane does not take it: the event-research lane's ceiling is a PR and its hard limit confirms only on IR:/BLS:/FED:. IMPACT low matches every sibling closure entry; symbols is empty because a closure removes sessions, it does not signal. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
